title: ADR-7: Cap the ledger pool at 20 connections per payments pod

nodes.label: Decision

props.title: Cap the ledger pool at 20 connections per payments pod
props.risk: Under burst traffic, requests beyond the pool size fail immediately unless a bounded wait queue is added in front of the pool.

nodes.quote: Each payments-core pod holds at most 20 ledger-db connections, so that all pods together stay under the ledger-db limit of 100.

links.quote: INC-088 took ledger-db down when payouts scaled out and the database ran out of connections.
